BEHIND THE WORK

The ideaThe focusWhere it stands

The idea

Translate the feeling of a physical transformation device into a browser interface and a set of watch-face visual experiments.

The focus

Explore a compact circular interface, distinctive visual states and playful interaction. A small project where the interface itself is the experiment.

Where it stands

A personal, unofficial fan-made simulator and visual study. It is not affiliated with the original franchise and does not claim a working smartwatch hardware integration.
